title: Squirm
tagline: Evolve a creature that runs on a real worm's nervous system, from a drop of water to a whole species, in three stages.
readinessNote: Three stages play end to end (about 20 minutes) with an ending. Body parts are a data table (S.PARTS in src/creature.js), but each stage is its own hand-written file with its world, rules and drawing in code; a fourth stage is a card only.
buildYourOwn: New body parts (stats, cost, the nerve cell they grow), new species in the Crawl, new mutations, a fourth stage.
